died.name: Andrew Perne
died.cause: The Vice-Chancellor of Cambridge University and Dean of Ely was known for his frequent religious conversions to match the established faith of the time in England. He reportedly died due to having heard the jester of Queen Elizabeth I make a joke about his uncertain spiritual state, referring to him as "one that is neither heaven nor earth, but hangs betwixt both".

died.name: John Wilkes Booth
died.desc: American actor and assassin of Abraham Lincoln
died.cause: after being fatally shot by Boston Corbett
died.last_words: Tell mother, tell mother, I died for my country...useless...useless...

died.name: Tom Ketchum
died.cause: executed by hanging for attempted train robbery
died.last_words: Goodbye. Please dig my grave very deep. All right; hurry up.

died.name: Doc Powers
died.cause: The 38-year-old American Major League Baseball player ran into a wall while chasing a foul ball during a Boston Red Sox-Philadelphia Athletics game at Philadelphia's Shibe Park, on 12 April 1909. He died from internal injuries and gangrene two weeks later.

died.name: Bobby Leach
died.cause: The American stunt performer died after a botched amputation of the infected leg which he had broken after slipping on an orange peel. He had gone over Niagara Falls in a barrel 15 years earlier.

died.name: Robert M. Bond
died.desc: United States Air Force lieutenant general
died.cause: prior to failed ejection from Mikoyan-Gurevich MiG-23 jet fighter-bomber
died.last_words: I've got to get out, I'm out of control.

died.name: Lucille Ball
died.desc: American actress, television producer and studio executive
died.cause: when asked if she wanted anything

born.name: Marcus Aurelius
born.last_words: Go to the rising sun, for I am setting. Think more of death than of me.

born.name: John James Audubon
born.cause: speaking to his friend William Bakewell while suffering from senility
born.last_words: Yes, yes, Billy! You go down that side on Long Pond, and I'll go this side, and we'll get the ducks.

born.name: Julius Peter Garesché
born.cause: The 41-year-old American professional soldier was killed on the first day of the Battle of Stones River when a cannonball decapitated him.

born.name: Ludwig Wittgenstein
born.cause: upon being told that his close friends would come to visit him the next day
born.last_words: Tell them I've had a wonderful life.

born.name: Stone Johnson
born.cause: after suffering fractured vertebra in neck during kickoff return on 30 August 1963
born.last_words: Oh my God, oh my God! Where's my head, where's my head?
